resources.string: Both sides are the same team
Pick a different team for home and away.
Title cannot be blank
The match title contains only whitespace. Enter a name or leave it unset.
A player appears in both rosters
The same player is selected as both benched and out of roster. Keep only one.
Phase length is invalid
The phase length must be greater than zero seconds.
No video selected
The video reference is blank. Select the video again.
Match time is invalid
Match time cannot be before zero seconds. Check the time.
Video time is invalid
Video time cannot be before zero seconds. Check the playback position.
Could not read the match time
The match time did not come through as a usable value. Enter the time again.
Could not read the playback position
The video position did not come through as a usable value. Wait for the video to load, or start playback and try again.
Wrong kind of timestamp
This recording mode does not accept that kind of timestamp. Use a time that matches the mode.
Title cannot be blank
The title field contains only whitespace. Enter a name or leave it unset.
Enter a note
The note field is blank. Enter something or leave it unset.
The same player is selected twice
The primary and related player are the same. Choose a different player.
Select a player
This kind of record needs a player. Choose the player it applies to.
The record is empty
Title, note, team, and player are all empty. Fill in at least one.
The phase has no end time
A phase start also needs an end time. Enter the phase length.
Start and end use different clocks
The phase start and end are anchored to different clocks. Use the same one for both.
The phase ends before it starts
The phase end must be later than its start. Check the times.
The stoppage ends before it starts
The stoppage end must be later than its start. Check the times.
The stoppage needs an end time
Video mode records a closed stoppage interval. Enter the end time.
The stoppage end will not be saved
Timer mode does not record a stoppage end. Remove the end time.
Timeouts cannot carry a note
A note cannot be saved on a timeout. Remove the note, or record it as a pause instead.
A blank note cannot be saved
The stoppage note contains only whitespace. Enter something or leave it unset.
That team is not in this match
This record refers to a team that is not part of the match. Choose the home or away team.
That player is not in this match
This record refers to a player that is not part of the match. Choose a player from either team.
Player and team do not match
The selected player does not belong to the selected team. Change the team or the player.
Related player and team do not match
The selected related player does not belong to the selected team. Change the team or the player.
No phase has been started
There are records but no phase start. Start a phase first.
No phase has been started
There are records but no phase start. Start a phase first.
Highlights cannot contain phases
Highlight recordings have no phase concept. Delete the phase start record.
Highlights cannot contain stoppages
Highlight recordings have no stoppage concept. Delete the stoppage record.
Highlights need a title
A highlight recording requires a title. Enter one.
A record falls outside every phase
A record sits outside the phases. Check its time, or the phase range.
A record falls inside a stoppage
A record sits in an interval where the match was stopped. Check the stoppage range, or the record time.
More than one shootout
A match has at most one shootout. Delete the extra shootout record.
A phase follows the shootout
The shootout is the final phase. No phase start can come after it.
The phase does not follow on from the previous one
A new phase must start at exactly the time the previous phase ended.
Stoppages overlap
One stoppage interval overlaps another. Tidy up the records.
A stoppage falls outside every phase
A stoppage sits outside the phases. Check the phase range, or the stoppage time.
Could not save
Something in the input needs fixing. Correct it and try again.
%1$d things need fixing.
This team is in use
The team is used by existing matches. Delete those matches first.
This player is in use
The player has records attached. Delete those records first.
Could not save
Something went wrong while saving. Try again in a moment.
Could not save
The save could not be prepared. Try again.
Cannot switch to video mode
Match time and video cannot be lined up yet. Add a sync point and try again.
Could not read the match data
The file does not have the expected contents. Try a different file.
